newsitem.title: USA: Johnson Controls to close parts plant.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Controls to close parts plant.

text.p: Johnson Controls Inc said Wednesday it plans to close its parts manufacturing plant in Milwaukee in about two years and move production to its other plants including one in Mexico.
About 200 jobs will be affected. Of that total, about 160 employees are members of the International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers. The balance are salaried workers.
The plant, which was opened in 1959, makes valves and other parts used in heating and air conditioning systems.
The decision to consolidate manufacturing and close the plant was based on the company's need to be more efficient to remain competitive, said Beverly Jurkowski, manager of employee communication.
Johnson Controls provides heating and air conditioning systems, automotive seating and automotive batteries.
